text: This document serves as the definitive schedule of charges and secured lending terms for NextGen Banking and Finance for the 2025/2026 fiscal year. All service fees are debited on the first business day of the month following the activity.

Our service charge structure is designed for transparency. The standard Monthly Maintenance Fee is £12.00, which is waived entirely for customers who maintain a Minimum Monthly Balance of £2,500 or have a total loan liability exceeding £15,000. Overdraft facilities are provided as a "Buffer" service; the first £50 of an arranged overdraft is interest-free. Beyond this, a fee of £1.50 per day applies for arranged usage, while unarranged overdrafts incur a penalty of £8.00 per day, capped at £80.00 per calendar month. Failed payment fees are £15.00 per occurrence. For global operations, NextGen charges a flat Foreign Remittance fee of £12.00 for outbound SWIFT transfers and £4.00 for SEPA transfers. Inbound foreign transfers are free, but a 2.5% "Currency Conversion Margin" is applied to the mid-market rate.

NextGen offers specialized Loan Against Securities (LAS) and Gold Loans for immediate liquidity. For LAS, the loan value is determined by the asset class: Shares and Equity Mutual Funds allow for a draw-down of up to 50% of the pledged value, capped at £20,000. Debt Mutual Funds offer a higher limit of 80% of the pledged value. Fixed Maturity Plans (FMPs) require a minimum loan of £1,000, while Sovereign Gold Bonds and Life Insurance Policies require a minimum of £500. Our Gold Loans are available to citizens aged 18-85, offering instant disbursal of up to £2,000,000 against gold jewellery. The interest rate for these secured products ranges from 8.75% to 16.65% per annum, with a processing fee of up to 2% of the loan amount plus applicable taxes.

We provide four flexible repayment options for secured loans: a "Bullet Repayment" at the end of the tenure, standard monthly principal and interest payments, an Overdraft facility where interest is only charged on the withdrawn amount, and a "Flexi-Pay" option which allows for repayment without foreclosure charges. Unlike standard personal loans, Gold Loan eligibility does not heavily weight credit scores or employment status, as the physical gold acts as the primary security. Regarding taxation, under the UK Foreign Income and Gains (FIG) regime, funds remitted through the Temporary Repatriation Facility (TRF) are subject to a fixed 12% tax rate.

The NextGen LearnFund and Credit suite provides specialized credit facilities for education and lifestyle management. These products are governed by the Consumer Credit Act and require specific eligibility evidence.

The NextGen Credit Card carries a standard purchase rate of 19.9% Variable APR. There is no annual fee, but a "Late Payment Penalty" of £12.00 is applied if the minimum payment (the greater of £5 or 3% of the balance) is not received by the due date. Cash advances on the card incur a 3% fee (minimum £3.00) and interest is charged from the date of withdrawal. For specialized education, the LearnFund provides capital for AI-specific courses. Beyond university degrees, we fund professional certifications from the following approved providers: DeepSkill Academy, NeuralPath Institute, CogniLearn Systems, Algorithmic Edge, Synapse Training Co., and TensorPro Education.

Loan amounts range from £500 to £30,000. Interest rates differ by qualification type: accredited university degrees and postgraduate programmes in AI, Machine Learning, or Data Science are financed at 3.2% APR. Professional certifications and short courses from approved providers are financed at 6.1% APR. The following are explicitly not eligible for LearnFund financing: bootcamps or intensive programmes shorter than 3 months in duration, self-paced courses without a formal assessment or graded examination, and any course or provider not appearing on the NextGen approved list. A repayment holiday (deferment) applies until 30 days after course completion. Documentation required for a LearnFund application includes a formal "Letter of Acceptance" from an approved provider and three months of payslips proving a minimum income of £1,500 per month. If a borrower wishes to "Foreclose" or settle their LearnFund early, they must pay the outstanding principal plus a flat £50.00 administrative discharge fee. Applications are processed through the NextGen Online Portal, with a dedicated "Education Support Liaison" assigned to each applicant during the 3–5 day underwriting window. Branch-specific services for LearnFund are limited to original document verification and high-value disbursement consultations (for loans over £20,000).

NextGen Banking and Finance operates as a digital-first institution with specific physical branch services available for complex wealth management. This guide outlines the mandatory operational procedures for account maintenance, opening, and lifecycle management.

To open any NextGen account, applicants must provide two distinct documents: a primary ID (valid UK Passport, EU National ID Card, or Full UK Driving Licence) and a secondary proof of address dated within the last 90 days (Utility bill, Council Tax statement, or HMRC correspondence). The account opening process is initiated via the NextGen Mobile Portal, featuring a mandatory "Liveness Check" biometrics scan, and typically results in a decision within 2 business hours. Upon approval, a Contactless Visa Debit ATM Card is dispatched via first-class post, arriving within 3–5 working days. This card carries a daily ATM withdrawal limit of £500 for Standard accounts and £1,000 for Platinum accounts.

Maintaining account activity is critical; an account is classified as "Inactive" if no customer-initiated transactions occur for 12 consecutive months. After 24 months of inactivity, the account is designated "Dormant." To reactivate a dormant account, the holder must submit a "Form D-1" along with fresh KYC (Know Your Customer) documentation and a physical signature verification at a partner branch. For those looking to leave NextGen, we adhere to the Current Account Switch Service (CASS) Guarantee, ensuring all balances and direct debits are transferred to another bank within 7 working days. Account closure or "Foreclosure" of a linked savings product is free of charge, provided the account is not in a negative balance.

For further assistance, please contact our support team at support@nextgenbank.co.ai or call 0800 123 4567. For formal complaints, please request the "Escalation Path" document or email our Head of Resolution at executive.office@nextgenbank.co.ai
